scope: Restore the existing LIFE Rooms view in Game of Worlds when served from the A0 Book root, without changing the LIFE engine, simulation state, view identity or scientific claims.

failure.observed: The parent switchboard received running state and generation updates while the Rooms viewport remained black.
failure.cause: Three.js 0.147.0, OrbitControls and GLTFExporter were referenced outside the A0 Book server root and returned HTTP 404. The simulation and message bridge continued, but the WebGL Rooms renderer could not initialize.
failure.boundary: This was a dependency-resolution and presentation failure, not a LIFE dynamics failure.

repair.runtime: Copy the already pinned Three.js 0.147.0 vendor files byte-identically into assets/game-of-worlds-play/vendor and resolve them locally.
repair.cache: Move the LIFE frame and renderer adapters to a 20261023 black-screen-recovery revision.
repair.fallback: If Three.js or WebGL is unavailable, show an explicit recoverable runtime message instead of an unexplained black viewport.
repair.source_contract: The source-copy manifest records the byte-identical vendor files and marks the locally adapted crystal renderer.

browser: Rooms renders the Source Field, 4+1 register, rosette/braid and boundary surfaces under the local Book server.
Rooms -> Field -> Rooms preserves the selected LIFE state.
PLAY advances from generation 24 to generation 27 after the repeated view activation.

authority.evidence_class: engineering runtime repair and local browser verification
